## Plan: UCF Coastal Research Center

**TL;DR** — Rework the current concept as a research-led UCF site, using Rosen College’s clarity and useful homepage pathways as broad inspiration—not copying its design. Follow the approved UCF web system, prioritize research collaboration, and use only verified center content.

**Steps**
1. **Review faculty guidance:** Read the searchable PDF and map its proposed content to the donor, faculty/researcher, and environmental-community audiences. Confirm content owners and real destinations before treating any claim as fact.
2. **Finalize navigation and page inventory:** Proposed menu, pending the PDF:
   - **Research**
   - **People & Resources**
   - **Impact & Partnerships**
   - **News & Events**
   - **About**
   - Primary action: **Collaborate on Research**. Keep **Support Coastal Research** visible as a secondary action, linked only to an approved giving destination.
   
   Keep navigation shallow and task-focused. Add student pathways, directories, search, or other sections only where the source content supports them.
3. **Align the published site with UCF:** Use the approved shared UCF header/theme and identity assets rather than the current homemade “UCF Coastal” lockup. Confirm UCF brand approval and available implementation components before changing the visual shell.
4. **Redesign the homepage:** Use an institutional hero, a featured research pathway, verified evidence of impact, current stories/events, and clear collaboration and giving routes. Keep the page within repository section limits; remove illustrative metrics, sample stories, and nonfunctional links.
5. **Validate:** Check responsive navigation, keyboard and screen-reader operation, contrast, link destinations, image licensing and credits, metadata/schema, forms, and UCF performance/accessibility standards.

**Relevant files**
- [index.html](index.html) — existing navigation, homepage sections, placeholder stories and actions.
- [styles.css](styles.css) — current custom identity, typography, colors, and responsive layout.
- [script.js](script.js) — mobile menu and demo newsletter behavior.
- [README.md](README.md) — update the stale note that the ideas PDF is missing after its contents are reviewed.
- [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md) — checked; it points to the repository’s standards.
- [docs/design-system.md](docs/design-system.md), [docs/information-architecture.md](docs/information-architecture.md), and [docs/page-templates.md](docs/page-templates.md) — repository design and structure requirements.

**Scope and dependencies**
- The PDF’s contents are still needed before finalizing the menu and page inventory.
- Research collaboration is the planned primary action; its actual destination must be confirmed.
- Don’t invent research results, statistics, staff, programs, events, or partnerships.
- This is the implementation plan only; no site files have been changed in this turn.
